events.event: The Indonesian Ulema Council (MUI) issued Fatwa No. 131 of 2026 declaring vaping (e-cigarettes) haram, covering use, production and trade, and urged the government and DPR to draft a ban law.
events.key_numbers: Fatwa Komisi Fatwa MUI No. 131 Tahun 2026 · dated 6 Nov 2026, reported 9 Nov
events.why_it_matters: Millions of vape users and sellers could face a legal ban if the government acts on the fatwa.
events.spreading_evidence: detik berita list #22 (1 hr ago, 9 Nov); covered by CNN, Okezone, Tempo EN, Tribun, iNews

events.event: Forestry Minister Raja Juli Antoni resigned as PSI secretary-general and from party activities, following Giring Ganesha, saying he wants to focus on Prabowo's forestry directives; Kaesang also acknowledged Giring, Isyana and Raja Juli leaving.
events.key_numbers: 3 senior PSI figures gone (Giring, Isyana, Raja Juli) · announced 9 Nov 2026 ~18:54 WIB
events.why_it_matters: PSI, Jokowi-linked party led by Kaesang, loses its top figures as ministers choose Prabowo's government.

events.event: Liputan6 fact-check rated as a hoax a Facebook photo claiming ex-President Jokowi was handcuffed over the Listyo Sigit wiretapping case; the image was edited from a YouTube thumbnail.
events.key_numbers: Posted 8 Nov 2026 · source video dated 5 Nov 2026 · Bareskrim has named 4 suspects (case does not involve Jokowi)
events.why_it_matters: Hoaxes are riding the wiretapping scandal; people believe wrongly that Jokowi was arrested.
events.spreading_evidence: Several fact-checks on wiretap hoaxes (Liputan6, InfoPublik, Harian Negeri); detik terpopuler #4 on the scandal itself

events.event: BNPB reported 782 karhutla hotspots across provinces with 1,534 ha being handled, with Central Kalimantan the highest at 359 hotspots (up 49%).
events.key_numbers: 782 hotspots · 1,534 ha · Kalteng 359 hotspots +49%, 755 ha · Papua Selatan 142 hotspots -4%, 257 ha · Kaltim 93 hotspots -22% · 43 air assets in 10 provinces (as of 8 Nov)
events.why_it_matters: Haze and fires continue into November, with Kalteng worsening while Papua Selatan eases.
events.spreading_evidence: detik news list 9 Nov; BNPB press conference

events.event: Prabowo is set to present national hero titles on Heroes' Day, with the Social Affairs Minister saying his grandfather Margono Djojohadikusumo is among those proposed.
events.key_numbers: 10 Nov 2026 (not a public holiday) · more than 10 names proposed (an 18 figure unconfirmed) · Margono Djojohadikusumo named
events.why_it_matters: A president naming his own grandfather a national hero draws attention to how the title is decided.
events.spreading_evidence: detik news list #10, #16; Suara, Liputan6, Katadata, ANTARA

events.why_it_matters: Commuters around Senayan and Sudirman face jams on Tuesday.
